# Validate startup ideas and generate business plans from Telegram with Perplexity and GPT-4o
# [Open full documentation on Notion](https://automatisation.notion.site/Startup-Idea-Validator-on-Telegram-Perplexity-GPT-4o-Course-Notes-3993d6550fd98187b93ee7cf30f33374)

Send a startup idea to your Telegram bot. The workflow scores it, asks you to approve a full analysis, runs live market and competitor research with Perplexity, structures everything with GPT-4o, validates demand with GPT-4o mini, writes a 10-section business plan into a Google Doc, logs a row to Google Sheets, and sends you the doc link on Telegram.

## How it works
1. Telegram Trigger receives the idea as free text.
2. GPT-4o mini structures and scores the idea (1-10).
3. Low scores get constructive feedback and stop; viable ideas trigger an approval button.
4. On approval, Perplexity researches market size and competitors (live web + sources).
5. GPT-4o structures market + competitor data and scores competitive position.
6. GPT-4o mini validates demand signals, risks and GTM; a composite score + recommendation are computed.
7. GPT-4o writes the full plan into a Google Doc; a summary row is logged to Sheets and the doc link is sent on Telegram.

## Setup
1. Open the Telegram Trigger and all Telegram nodes and select YOUR bot credential.
2. Select your OpenAI, Perplexity, Google Docs and Google Sheets credentials on their nodes.
3. In Log To Google Sheets, pick your spreadsheet from the Document dropdown (a sheet/tab named "plan" with the provided headers).
4. Open the Configuration node and adjust defaults (min score, default country, models, Docs folder).
5. Activate the workflow and send an idea to your bot.

## Requirements
- Telegram bot (via @BotFather)
- OpenAI API key (GPT-4o and GPT-4o mini)
- Perplexity API key (Sonar models)
- Google account with Docs + Sheets (OAuth2)

## Customization
- Everything adjustable lives in the Configuration node: score threshold, default country, model names, Perplexity model, Docs folder.
- Swap gpt-4o / gpt-4o-mini for newer models (e.g. gpt-5-mini) directly in Configuration.
- Raise Perplexity to sonar-reasoning-pro for deeper research, or lower to sonar to cut cost.
- Remove the approval step to run fully automatically (not recommended, you keep an eye on quality).

## 1. Idea intake & scoring
Founder sends an idea on Telegram. Configuration centralizes all settings. GPT-4o mini structures and scores it.

## 2. Filter & human approval
Weak ideas get feedback and stop. Viable ideas ask you to approve the full analysis before spending on research.

## 3. Live research (Perplexity)
Sonar models research market size, growth, trends and real competitors, returning sources.

## 4. Analysis & scoring (GPT-4o)
GPT-4o structures market + competitor data; GPT-4o mini validates demand. A composite score and recommendation are computed.

## 5. Business plan & delivery
GPT-4o writes the plan into a Google Doc, logs a row to Sheets, and sends the doc link on Telegram.
